# Keeper's hut: whitewashed walls 2.4 x 2.0 x 1.7, a dark gabled roof (ridge along X), a chimney, a dark
# door and window painted as protruding slabs a full splat proud. Up Z, facing -Y.
new
add mesh cube --name Walls --size 1 --location 0 0 0.85
scale 2.4 2.0 1.7
apply --scale
material new White --base-color 0.941 0.965 0.941
add mesh cube --name Gable --size 1 --location 0 0 2.1
scale 2.4 2.0 0.8
apply --scale
material assign White
active Gable
mode edit
select vert where "pos.z > 0"
scale 1 0 1
merge --by-distance 0.001
mode object
add mesh cube --name RoofF --size 1 --location 0 -0.62 2.15
scale 2.7 1.45 0.18
apply --scale
set rotation 38.7 0 0
material new Dark --base-color 0.133 0.137 0.137
add mesh cube --name RoofB --size 1 --location 0 0.62 2.15
scale 2.7 1.45 0.18
apply --scale
set rotation -38.7 0 0
material assign Dark
add mesh cube --name Chimney --size 1 --location 0.75 0.35 2.5
scale 0.32 0.32 0.9
apply --scale
material assign Dark
add mesh cube --name Door --size 1 --location -0.45 -1.04 0.55
scale 0.55 0.1 1.1
apply --scale
material assign Dark
add mesh cube --name Window --size 1 --location 0.55 -1.04 1.0
scale 0.5 0.1 0.45
apply --scale
material assign Dark
select all
shade flat
export hut.glb
